local_names.this: instance pointer whose +0x0 holds the render-object pointer

operations.description: Invoke F_3DTransformWithMatrixMultiplication(this, &v6, v8) to apply a 3D transform matrix multiplication, writing a float into v6 and 3 DWORDs into v8.
Invoke RenderCallWithGuard(*(_DWORD**)this, &v7, v9), dereferencing the render-object pointer at this+0x0 as the first argument and passing locals v7/v9.
Return (v3 | v4) != 0, where v3 and v4 are the c0/c2 status flags captured from x87 FP comparisons performed inside the callees.
